scope_review: Scope is honestly represented. The video models exactly one duplicated chromosome (one sister pair), consistent with the model's deliberate single-chromosome instantiation of the source's 'all chromosomes align' statement. The anaphase caption explicitly states 'Molecular cleavage not shown,' matching the exclusion of cohesin degradation/cleavage; no molecular mechanism is depicted or implied. Phase order shown (bipolar kinetochore attachment -> metaphase-plate alignment -> sister separation to opposite poles) matches the schematic process order. No out-of-scope process (interphase replication, prophase NEBD, telophase, cytokinesis, SAC) is depicted. Schematic (not molecular-structure) interpretation is appropriate and is what the scene presents.

Caption: 'Kinetochores of sister chromatids bind microtubules from opposite poles.' Bipolar orientation correct.
